Title: Classic Datil Hot Sauce
Description: The datil pepper, straight up — fruity, bright, and genuinely hot. No smoke, nothing extra. Just the sauce doing its thing on your eggs, your tacos, your everything.
Ingredients: Datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.
Pairings: Eggs, tacos, grilled chicken, rice bowls, burgers, roasted vegetables.

Title: Smoked Datil Hot Sauce
Description: Datil peppers over applewood before the sauce is ever made — smoke woven in from the start, not layered on top. Fruity heat with real depth. This is the one for anything off the grill.
Ingredients: Smoked datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.
Pairings: Brisket, pulled pork, chili, burgers, smoked wings, grilled vegetables.
